en.summary: This commit fixes partial-SIMD dispatch and control sequencing. The operand collector now iterates only non-empty SIMD packets and propagates true sop/eop boundaries, so sparse lane masks no longer cause packet skipping, premature scoreboard release, or wrong per-packet control behavior.
why_it_counts: The patch changes operand collection, dispatch, and control-path RTL rather than only utility code.
It adds new state and packet-boundary signals that change architectural issue behavior for sparse masks.
The supporting ALU and warp-control fixes show the bug affected real execution semantics, not just tracing.
disqualifiers: The commit also bundles unrelated library and cache fixes, so the exact bug set is broader than one defect.
evidence: VX_opc_unit.sv replaces the old simd_index walk with VX_nz_iterator so only non-empty SIMD packets are issued and sop/eop are tracked explicitly.
VX_dispatch.sv starts carrying sop and eop in the dispatch payload instead of relying on a derived last_active_tid-only scheme.
VX_dispatch_unit.sv switches warp_sop and warp_eop to use dispatch_sop and dispatch_eop rather than reconstructing boundaries from sid alone.
VX_alu_int.sv and VX_wctl_unit.sv replace execute_if.data.tid-based selection with last-active-lane selection derived from the actual tmask.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When a vector or SIMD instruction is split into internal packets, packet boundaries must reflect the actual active-lane pattern, not just a fixed packet index count. If the operand collector steps through every nominal packet, including empty ones, or if sop/eop are regenerated from local packet indices instead of carried from the real active-packet iterator, sparse masks break the control contract between operand collection, dispatch, scoreboard, and commit.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An instruction has a sparse active-lane mask so only some internal SIMD packets are non-empty, especially when multiple outer SIMD slices are present.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Revert to a fixed packet-index walk and regenerate sop/eop from packet index rather than from the actual non-empty packet iterator.
portability_notes: Map this to any operand-collection or issue stage that decomposes wide lane masks into smaller packets.
The bug is about handling empty packets and true first/last packet boundaries.
Keep operand fetch and arithmetic unchanged; only damage the iterator and boundary tags.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that enumerates internal SIMD packets for one architectural instruction.
Make it walk packets by fixed index even when a packet has no active lanes, or otherwise ignore the non-empty packet iterator result.
Derive sop and eop from packet index and slice number rather than preserving them from the iterator output.
Leave downstream execution units intact so the failure shows up as skipped packets, wrong control timing, or premature unlock.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: operand-collector SIMD packet iterator and sop/eop propagation into dispatch/control units
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix added VX_nz_iterator-based packet enumeration, propagated sop/eop through operands and dispatch, and corrected per-packet lane selection in ALU and warp-control logic.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Revert VX_opc_unit.sv to the old simd_index progression, stop carrying sop/eop in VX_dispatch.sv, and restore VX_dispatch_unit.sv to reconstruct warp_sop and warp_eop from sid-derived assumptions.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Sparse-lane instructions can skip valid packets, mark first or last packet boundaries incorrectly, unlock scoreboards too early, or apply control side effects using the wrong active lane.
evidence_for_injection: The new VX_nz_iterator exists solely to iterate non-empty packets and emit correct sop/eop tags.
Both VX_dispatch.sv and VX_dispatch_unit.sv were changed specifically to carry those packet-boundary tags instead of re-deriving them.
ALU and warp-control fixes based on tmask-derived last-lane selection confirm the bug reached architectural execution behavior.
notes: This commit also includes other fixes, including library and cache changes; the sparse-packet boundary bug is the most portable injection target.
A sparse tmask pattern that activates only middle packets is the clearest reproducer.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 partial-SIMD 的 dispatch 与控制时序。operand collector 现在只遍历非空 SIMD 子包，并传播真实的 sop/eop 边界，因此稀疏 lane mask 不会再导致 packet 被跳过、scoreboard 过早释放，或每个 packet 的控制行为错误。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 operand collection、dispatch 和控制路径 RTL，而不是仅改工具代码。
它新增了状态与 packet 边界信号，直接改变稀疏 mask 下的体系结构发射行为。
ALU 和 warp-control 的配套修复说明这个问题影响了真实执行语义，而不是只影响 trace。
disqualifiers: 该提交也打包了其它库和 cache 修复，因此整体缺陷集合比单一问题更宽。
evidence: VX_opc_unit.sv 用 VX_nz_iterator 取代了旧的 simd_index 遍历，因此只会发射非空 SIMD 子包，并显式跟踪 sop/eop。
VX_dispatch.sv 开始在 dispatch payload 中携带 sop 和 eop，而不再依赖只基于 last_active_tid 的旧方案。
VX_dispatch_unit.sv 改为使用 dispatch_sop 和 dispatch_eop 来生成 warp_sop 与 warp_eop，而不是仅由 sid 推导边界。
VX_alu_int.sv 和 VX_wctl_unit.sv 把基于 execute_if.data.tid 的选择替换成了根据真实 tmask 推导的 last-active-lane 选择。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当一条向量或 SIMD 指令被拆成多个内部 packet 时，packet 边界必须反映真实的 active-lane 分布，而不是固定 packet 编号数量。如果 operand collector 仍然按名义 packet 顺序逐个推进，包括空 packet 在内，或者 sop/eop 仍然依据本地 packet 编号重建，而不是从真实的非空 packet 迭代器中传递，那么稀疏 mask 会破坏 operand collection、dispatch、scoreboard 和 commit 之间的控制契约。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 稀疏 packet 迭代与 packet 边界传播
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一条指令的 active-lane mask 很稀疏，因此只有部分内部 SIMD packet 非空，尤其是在存在多个外层 SIMD slice 时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 恢复成固定 packet-index 遍历，并根据 packet index 而不是实际非空 packet 迭代结果来重新生成 sop/eop。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何把宽 lane mask 分解成较小 packet 的 operand-collection 或 issue 阶段。
关键缺陷是对空 packet 与真实 first/last packet 边界的处理错误。
保持 operand fetch 与算术执行不变，只破坏迭代器和边界标签。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到为一条体系结构指令枚举内部 SIMD packet 的逻辑。
让它重新按固定 packet 序号遍历，即使某个 packet 没有任何 active lane，也继续推进，或者直接忽略非空 packet 迭代器的结果。
根据 packet 编号和 slice 编号推导 sop/eop，而不是沿用迭代器输出的真实边界。
保持下游执行单元不变，使故障表现为 packet 被跳过、控制时序错误或过早解锁。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: operand collector 的 SIMD packet 迭代器，以及进入 dispatch/control 单元的 sop/eop 传播
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复引入了基于 VX_nz_iterator 的 packet 枚举，沿着 operands 和 dispatch 传播 sop/eop，并在 ALU 与 warp-control 逻辑中修正了每个 packet 的活跃 lane 选择。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 VX_opc_unit.sv 恢复成旧的 simd_index 推进方式，在 VX_dispatch.sv 中停止携带 sop/eop，并把 VX_dispatch_unit.sv 恢复成基于 sid 假设来重建 warp_sop 和 warp_eop。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 稀疏 lane 指令可能跳过合法 packet、错误标记 first/last packet 边界、过早释放 scoreboard，或者用错误的 active lane 去执行控制副作用。
evidence_for_injection: 新增的 VX_nz_iterator 专门用于遍历非空 packet 并输出正确的 sop/eop 标签。
VX_dispatch.sv 与 VX_dispatch_unit.sv 都被改成传递这些 packet 边界标签，而不再自行重建。
基于 tmask 推导最后活跃 lane 的 ALU 和 warp-control 修复说明这个问题已经影响到体系结构级执行行为。
notes: 该提交还包含其它修复，例如库和 cache 修改；稀疏 packet 边界错误是其中最适合可移植回注的故障。
只激活中间 packet 的稀疏 tmask 模式是最清晰的复现条件。
